packagesSection.intro: Per person, priced exactly like our flyers. Asia trips are all-in; ask us for each long-haul tour’s inclusions. Departures out of Manila, Davao, Cebu or Clark, depending on the tour.
packagesSection.asiaNote: One price covers the lot. Tell us your dates and headcount and we’ll confirm the final rate.
packagesSection.longhaulNote: Prices are per pax. Airline taxes, visa fees, travel insurance and tipping are usually on top; we’ll spell it out in your quote.
packagesSection.footNote: Group or company tour? We quote those too.
packagesSection.confirmNote: Prices are “from” rates copied from our current flyers and can change. We confirm your final price before you pay.

toursSection.intro: Our long tours, laid out the way the flyer does it: where you sleep, what you see and which meals are covered, every day.

servicesSection.intro: One local office for the whole trip, from the ticket to the transfer.

steps.title: Inquire
steps.text: Message us on Facebook or call. Tell us where, when and how many.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: We send options and a full quote. Pick the one that fits your barkada and budget.

steps.title: Pay
steps.text: Confirm your booking and pay. Major credit cards are accepted, with installment options.

steps.title: Travel
steps.text: Get your itinerary, pack, and go. Questions along the way? Just message us.

howToBook.installmentNote: Installment options are subject to your card issuer’s terms and approval.

paragraphs: CheaPOX Travel and Tours is a travel and tours agency on J.P. Rizal St. in Mendez, Cavite. Our name is our promise, and so is our tagline: the trip should be cheap, and still oks na oks.

Arnel V. Bael, our owner and travel consultant, handles every inquiry personally. Send your dates, headcount and budget, and you’ll get options that fit, from all-in Asia trips to escorted tours in Europe and the Middle East, out of Manila, Davao, Cebu or Clark, depending on the tour.
Barkadas, families and company groups are all welcome. Drop by the office, or just message us.

gallerySection.intro: A few of the places our packages go. Tap any photo’s tag to jump to its package.

testimonialsSection.intro: What travelers tell us after the trip, in their own words.

contactSection.intro: Walk in, call, or message. Whatever’s easiest for you.
